fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE
source: Manohar et al. (2012) J. Electrochem. Soc. 159(8) A1209; Trocino et al. (2022) J. Power Sources 523, 230999; McKerracher et al. (2015) Electrochim. Acta 184, 264; Form Energy (2022) iron-air long-duration storage technology report; Newman & Thomas-Alyea (2004) Electrochemical Systems, 3rd ed., Wiley

unit.name: Iron-Air Cell — Physics-Lumped (Fe/Fe(OH)2 anode + bifunctional air cathode)

A_cell.note: Geometric electrode area (lab-scale Fe-air cell, McKerracher 2015)

E0_anode.note: Fe(OH)2/Fe standard potential vs SHE in alkaline. Fe + 2OH- -> Fe(OH)2 + 2e-. Manohar 2012

E0_cathode.note: O2 + 2H2O + 4e- -> 4OH- ORR standard potential vs SHE (alkaline). Newman 2004

E0_HER.note: 2H2O + 2e- -> H2 + 2OH- HER standard potential vs SHE (alkaline). Drives charge-side parasitic

j0_anode.note: Fe/Fe(OH)2 exchange current density (sluggish, passivating). Manohar 2012

j0_ORR.note: ORR exchange current density at bifunctional air cathode (slow ORR). McKerracher 2015

j0_OER.note: OER exchange current density on charge (very slow -> large charge overpotential)

j0_HER.note: HER exchange current density on Fe during charge (parasitic H2 evolution). Manohar 2012

j_L_O2.note: Air-cathode O2 limiting current density (gas-diffusion mass transport). McKerracher 2015

R_ohmic.note: Area-specific ohmic resistance (KOH electrolyte + separator + GDL). Trocino 2022

E_act.note: Activation energy for kinetics/ohmic Arrhenius temperature dependence. Trocino 2022

current_density.note: positive=discharge, negative=charge. Slow Fe-air kinetics limit rate
